text_block_list.text:
A few weeks after Mejiro Ramonu made her 
brilliant debut—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now, go ahead and sit.

For some reason, I found myself in the 
student council room, facing none other 
than Symboli Rudolf and Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Please, don't hold back.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"That sofa over there... It's not 'so 
far', is it?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Sofa... so far. ...The sounds are close, 
but is the context too shallow?

Her name is Symboli Rudolf... Tracen 
Academy's student council president, and 
the first Umamusume in history to capture 
the Classic Triple Crown undefeated from 
her debut.

I went to witness that historic moment 
myself. I can still remember the thrilling 
beat of my heart from that very day—
choice_data_list:
(To think an Umamusume like her would 
choose me...!)

(To think an Umamusume like her would 
choose me...!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hey, this person looks really nervous.

And she is an incredible Umamusume as 
well! Mr. C.B.... achieved the Classic 
Triple Crown the year before Symboli 
Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Let's definitely go outside! The weather's 
so nice, and it's way more relaxing to 
unwind while on a run!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, Trainer won't be able to 
speak."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Really? You never know until you try.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hey. You're my Trainer, so... surely you 
can handle about a 15km jog, right?
choice_data_list:
Um, could we get to the main topic 
soon...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You're right, I'm sorry. Let us not waste 
our precious time in idle dithering.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Though to be fair, it barely even had 
anything to do with the main topic.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—I simply wanted to have a chat with the 
one who became Mejiro Ramonu's Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Well, that's how it is for me, 
at least.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I thought Rudolf might have been plotting 
to check up on Ramonu's Trainer a bit 
more...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even I act without deep reflection 
sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Simply because I was curious, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...You are aware of the relationship 
between our Symboli family and the Mejiro 
family, right?

Both are household names of prestigious 
lineage. The Symboli family, who have 
carried the history of horse girls for 
generations and dedicated themselves to 
their progress...

"And likewise, the prestigious Mejiro 
family, who has produced countless 
prominent Umamusume and made their name 
echo throughout racing. There isn't a 
single person in the racing world who 
doesn't know them."
choice_data_list:
Both families are treasures of the racing 
world!

Both families are treasures of the racing 
world!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Throughout the long history of the 
Umamusume world, we have been bound by 
deep ties... and fulfilled our respective 
roles."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Achieving the undefeated Classic Triple 
Crown. That is my duty. And...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ramonu, who could be called the embodiment 
of both families' passion for racing... is 
expected to achieve history's first Triple 
Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I, too... am craning my neck in eager 
anticipation for that moment.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I hear that you, too, are someone who 
loves racing... just like Ramonu... no, 
just like the rest of us.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Please, lend her your strength. And 
together... let us build a wonderful 
future.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...I knew it, you didn't just want to 
talk, did you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"No... I apologize. Being overly formal is 
simply in my nature."

To receive words of encouragement directly 
from Symboli Rudolf herself... As a 
Trainer, nothing could honor me more.
choice_data_list: I will give it my all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...You have my thanks.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I know how she runs. She will definitely 
pull it off.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And someday, I would love to work 
alongside you as equals.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Not drinking together slowly and having 
a heart-to-heart, then?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If it's with her, I'd love nothing more 
than to talk about creating the future.

Right then, a thought crossed my mind. In 
the future Symboli Rudolf speaks of...

Does she envision competing against Mejiro 
Ramonu? Considering the relationship 
between both families, it's a wonderfully 
dreamy and fascinating prospect, but...
choice_data_list:
Is there a future where I face off against 
Ramonu?

Is there a future where I'll get to race 
Ramonu?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —...So that's why Rudolf didn't answer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes...
choice_data_list: What are your thoughts on the future?
What do you think about the future?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I, however, already have one.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
The past, the present, the future... 
Everything is right here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Before you can even envision it, 
everything has already been decided.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: My motive is simply love.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Let us resume.

"The future already exists—I didn't know 
her true meaning, but she seemed to see a 
vision different from Symboli Rudolf's... 
Or so I thought."
